title: What Are 'AI Cops'? A Plain-Language Guide to the Tech Being Sold to Your Police
angle: Investigative reports reveal a boom in AI tools for law enforcement. We explain what these systems—from predictive policing to automated report-writing—actually do, and why experts are sounding the alarm about bias and accountability.
rationale: This piece demystifies a controversial and consequential application of AI, making a complex societal issue accessible to a broad audience.

source_articles.title: Computer cops

Thousands gathered inside to see what had been billed as "the future of policing in the digital age."
